messages:
Sam L: Heads up — heavy storm heading into SF tonight. Caltrain just posted reduced service and SFO flight delays starting ~8pm. Planning to come in tomorrow? :umbrella:
Maya R: Staying remote tomorrow. 101 cams look awful, Caltrans shows 30–45m delays.
Kevin C: On BART now, slowed at Embarcadero. Train keeps stopping between stations, ETA unclear :grimacing:
Anya P: Power flickered here earlier so WFH for me. If someone needs coverage in-office I can try but prefer remote. :house_with_garden:
Sam L: Thanks — I’ll update the desk map if people bail. Anyone in SoMa who can carpool tomorrow?
Kevin C: If BART is flaky I might try bike + MUNI replacement but could be slower.
TransitBot: Caltrain advisory: https://www.caltrain.com/advisories — reduced weekday service due to weather. Expect delays 30–60 min.
Maya R: N‑Judah reporting partial suspension between 9th & Judah and Sunset. Might affect some routes.
Anya P: I usually take the 7X so I should be fine. Appreciate the heads-up.
Sam L: Office plants will survive without us :seedling: If commute gets worse we’ll keep office open but no pressure to show.
Kevin C: PSA for bikers — bring lights and extra layers, wind gusts are pretty bad tonight.
Maya R: Quick poll: reply with 'in' or 'remote' if you plan to be in the SF office tomorrow.
Anya P: remote
Kevin C: probably remote (depends on BART)
Sam L: in early but can switch to remote if needed
Maya R: Cool, I’ll post the summary to #lunch-plans later in case folks want to coordinate rides. Stay safe y’all :heart:
